name: amm
description: An AMM over 1Color tokens, the Open Exchange (docs/AMM.md), as its TOKEN app. 0.52.0: a trade's `at` (every hop's) is decided once when it is recorded — its block's time when the transaction is already mined then (a history load, a catch-up sync), else the step's time; a later proof changes nothing. 0.51.0 (skein-overlay 0.28.0, skein-chain 0.12.0): a swap is one step — checked (every input unspent in this instance's view before signing), signed, the pool input's script run on the finished transaction, handed to the overlay by its in-VM intake (ingested, broadcast and admitted in that step) and answered with the overlay's verdict; the pool locks (amm/locks), the pending answer and the ask-again path are gone. 0.50.1: the validator checks the request's scripts and signatures once, before the lock (D6); its second, signature-only check in `spend` goes (the reasons missing_signature and bad_signature with it); skein-sdk 0.21.3 (a held transaction a BEEF carries raw is not script-checked again). 0.50.0: on skein-overlay 0.27.0 (the lookup raises and reads its own events) and skein 0.8.0 (a step sees its own events): a Swap in the same step as its pool is recognised; the lookup's answers read spent-ness from chain/output; the validator reads a transaction's status from the chain state. 0.49.0: the pool lookup is a recognizer — it emits amm/pool/<poolId>, amm/output/<txid>.<vout>, amm/hop and amm/commission/<txid>.<vout> and stores only its counters and the token fee tally (read /fees/tokens); /trades, /candles, /stats, /pools/at, /pools/history, /fees/validator and /fees/commission are gone from the instance (the host folds the events); the commission key is per swap ([1, amm commission] keyed by the spent pool outpoint, counterparty anyone; /terms answers market.identityKey); the validator's wallet-funded Rescind is gone (roles: {root: [terms, market]}); no reindex, no lookupVersion, no libp2p receive row (CHANGELOG.md). Before: An AMM over 1Color tokens, the Open Exchange (docs/AMM.md), as its TOKEN app (0.22.0, shruggr/skein-amm#5: the token comes as one event, {kind: "deploy", beef} in the box amm/deploy (event route, filter kernel.beef: the BEEF checked by the door against chain/state, the record carrying its envelope); amm-setup's step writes the head amm/token {tokenId, topic, lookup, ammLookup, sym, dec, icon?, txid, vout} (once: a second deploy event is refused, nothing written) and registers with the engine by in-VM call (skein-overlay 0.18.0) tm_color_<tokenId> (color-topic, seeded with the deploy), ls_color_<tokenId> (color-lookup) and ls_amm_<tokenId> (amm-lookup) over it, then submits the deploy to its own engine in amm/submit when the seed did not take it; the read /token answers the record. 0.17.0 to 0.21.1: the names came from the config instance's create (apps/config, still working, superseded by shruggr/open-exchange#1)). before that (0.17.0, shruggr/skein-amm#4: one token instance per token id, created by the config instance's enable — apps/config — with this app's topic, lookup and initial values in its config at birth): the overlay engine (shruggr/skein-overlay 0.20.0: announce, then fetch — the <topic> mesh carries only admit verdicts, the host fetches the BEEF; no wants; every proof published; the sync tail read; 0.18.0: 0.17.0: a topic and lookup service in config.overlay beat as registered ones; config.overlay.terms the beat's initial terms; required: chain/1; its filter sync answers the overlay sync protocol, libp2p /skein/overlay/sync/1.0.0, through the front door on that row: a read, nothing logged, shruggr/skein#154; its receive row, libp2p /skein/overlay/beef/1.0.0 (filter kernel.beef, handler overlay.submit), the host's own entry, not served to peers: each Atomic BEEF the host fetches, handed to it as from the peer it came from) with the 1Color components (shruggr/skein-1color 0.13.1, BRC-162 and BRC-207: the topic manager color-topic, one topic per token tm_color_<assetId> (BRC-207: tm_color_<txid>_0, tm_color_<txid>_<vout>) and the discovery topic tm_color; the lookup color-lookup under a name paired with the topic that feeds it, the same queries under every name: a token instance's ls_color_<assetId> over tm_color_<assetId> (BRC-207's color-spendability and color-admission), the discovery instance's ls_color over tm_color (BRC-207's queries with topic tm_color: a token's deploy); 0.20.0: ls_color_deploys gone, and a token instance serves no ls_color; the token list, the read route /color/tokens of color-lookup), the pool lookup ls_amm_<assetId> (amm-lookup, 0.21.0: one name per token, paired with tm_color_<assetId> as ls_color_<assetId> is, each query naming its token: a pool is listed only when it attests itself: its ValidatorPubKey the ValidatorIdentity's child keyed by the Nonce in its state, derived by the lookup, and the Affirmation in its state that key's signature of the pool's parameters; a Swap's continuation of a listed pool is listed when its ValidatorPubKey is the identity's child keyed by the spent pool outpoint; the LP's Close and the validator's Rescind end it), the validator (amm-validator: swap as a libp2p direct call, it signs last and submits to its own overlay by message, {fn: "submit"} in the box submit (<app>/submit); affirm, called in-VM by amm.pool.affirm: a proposed pool checked against the validator's terms (0.15.0: the record amm/terms {lpFeeBps, validatorFeeBps, commissionBps} root sets with {fn: "terms", args} in the box amm/validator, args null clearing them; none set, a market only: affirm and the swap signing refused "no terms: this skein validates nothing", amm.pool.terms "no validator here", the beat without terms; no fee numbers in the manifest), a random nonce picked, the validator's key derived from it and the pool signed by that key, answered {validatorPubKey, nonce, signature}; and root's {fn: "rescind", args: {pool}} in the box validator (<app>/validator): the contract's Rescind, the pool written back with its ValidatorPubKey cleared, the pool a caller input of the instance's wallet, which pays the fee) and amm-p2p: the app's functions (its box <app>/amm-p2p and the route /call; amm.swap/1: terms (this exchange's commission pkh, hash160 of the instance's own key for the commission: BRC-43 level 1, protocol amm commission, key ID relay, counterparty anyone; no config since 0.16.0; and the market's minCommissionBps, the record amm/market {minCommissionBps} root sets with {fn: "market", args: {minCommissionBps}} in the box amm/amm-p2p, args null clearing it, unset 0: a listing preference of this market, the pools the Swap page lists, nothing refusing by it); 0.44.0: no relay in the instance (its submit and status functions, its records and their read gone: the instance logs facts, never attempts) — the open-exchange host carries a taker's swap to the validator the caller names, its route POST /@<tokenId>/amm/swap, checking only that the commission pays this exchange's key; amm.pool/1: terms, and affirm, answered by this instance's own validator in-VM), and the chain state of an outpoint (the read route /spends). 0.34.0, the public read API (docs/AMM.md "The public read API"; plain GETs, JSON unless bytes, comma lists answered one record per key in query order, cache headers per class): /positions?lp=, /fees/validator?id=, /fees/commission?pkh= (the pool lookup's own list answers), /terms (the validator's terms and the market's in one, unsigned), /spends?outpoint=a,b (0.47.0: an outpoint's spender, one lookup, no pool following), /tx?id= (a transaction's BEEF, immutable once proven); the pools route itself, /pools, is the host's (it joins its liveness and the market minimum). 0.36.0, the history reads (docs/AMM.md "The history reads"): the pool lookup writes one trade row per admitted Swap (txid, LP key, side, amounts in and out, the three fees, the reserves after, the admitting step's time; the map trades by time), answered by /trades (newest first, a window, a cursor, ?lp=, ?txid=; each row's height from the overlay's placed), /candles (tf 1m to 1d, one candle per non-empty bucket, computed on read) and /stats (the last 24 h of trades and the live pools). 0.37.0: on skein-1color 0.15.0, the token's 1Color reads under the prefix row /color/ (filter colorToken, color-lookup.token): /color/<tokenId>/holders?limit=&skip= the token's holders from color-lookup's balance table over its P2PKH value outputs, {count, rows: [{address, balance}]} largest first. The pages are the config app's (0.17.0). The contract is Swap (the validator's), Close (the LP's alone, its outputs free) and Rescind (the validator's: the pool written back with its ValidatorPubKey cleared, no Swap after it). A deploy is the LP's wallet's (BRC-207), submitted to the token topic like any token transaction. Anyone submits to the engine by message in the box submit, answered by message, or by POST /submit, BRC-22: it waits and answers the STEAK. The manifest declares no per-token topic: a token instance's config at birth names it (config.overlay.topics {tm_color_<tokenId>: color-topic}, config.overlay.lookups ls_amm_<tokenId> {program: amm-lookup} and ls_color_<tokenId> {program: color-lookup, topics: [tm_color_<tokenId>]} (0.21.0: the manifest declares no lookup, no ls_amm; 0.21.1: its config.overlay is {}, kept because skein derives the engine's routes — the box amm (event, mailbox), /submit, /lookup — from the manifest's own config.overlay; 0.20.0: no ls_color, no ls_color_deploys), config.overlay.terms and config["amm-p2p"].market the admin's defaults, each the INITIAL value: root's terms and market messages to /@<tokenId> write the heads, which win); the register box is gone (roles: {root: [rescind, terms, market]}); topics registered by an earlier version stay served. The validator signs for every topic the engine serves, configured or registered. Every skein is a market and a validator, always (skein-overlay 0.12): the configured topic and lookups beat on <name>-live (config.overlay.market {window} / .validator {every}, else 40 000 / 30 000 ms; this manifest sets neither). 0.47.0: /pools/beef gone (a pool's transaction is /tx?id= of its current outpoint's txid); /trades stepped back from the window's end; the pool lookup's counters (per pool its lifetime volume and fees and last trade, on the pool row as lifetime; per token its volume and trades, on /stats; per validator its Swaps and fees), written at admission and unwound at rejection. 0.48.0: one record per pool hop (pools and spentPools link the hop's history row); the pool lookup's maps fees, byPool, byValidator, rescinded and beat gone, and no beat body of its own (the host and the pages read tm_color_<assetId>-live); /stats the last fill, the volumes and the counts only (the TVL, the pool count and the price are the host's). 0.48.1: reindex (skein-overlay 0.23.0): root's {fn: "reindex", args: {service}} in the box amm/reindex (the handler overlay.reindex, gated by root) derives ls_amm_<assetId>'s or ls_color_<assetId>'s index again from tm_color_<assetId>'s admitted history in place (one transaction per step; the index's head switched in the last); lookupVersion (1, the 0.48.0 record shape) is raised when a release changes the lookups' record shape, so a host reindexes after an upgrade.
